description: Reviewed Korean for the two genuine Name75 residual targets. The remaining Name75 targets reference FF-page dictionary indices that do not resolve in the Original ROM and are held back pending an exclusion decision.

name75:75C198.review_notes: broken_word: the unit name ジオング was half localized, leaving グ glued to the Korean 지온. The Original record is ジオング and out/patch/name75_ko_report.json lists this address as skipped with reason no_translation, so the complete name is replaced with 지옹.

name75:75E597.review_notes: The Original record is 暗礁宙域; 宙域 was already localized to 공역 through the shared dictionary, leaving 暗礁 in Japanese. Replaced the complete term.
